generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Kayaking and paddleboarding (皮划艇与桨板活动). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a lakeside launch area from a slightly elevated angle before anyone enters the water. Position one touring kayak on its transport trolley along the left and one inflated paddleboard on the right, leaving a clear strip of shore between them. Lay the double-bladed paddle diagonally in the lower third; place the spray skirt, buoyancy aid, closed dry bag and waterproof phone pouch separately on a timber landing. Connect one coiled ankle leash to the board and stand the manual pump nearby. Two paddlers may wait in the background wearing ordinary clothes, not yet handling the equipment. Use fresh morning light and calm water. No white-water action, loose duplicate paddles, brand graphics, readable phone screen, children without supervision or equipment floating unsupported.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: touring sea kayak, stand-up paddleboard, double-bladed kayak paddle, coiled paddleboard ankle leash, roll-top dry bag, paddling buoyancy aid, kayak spray skirt, waterproof phone pouch, manual paddleboard pump, kayak transport trolley.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
